title: Morshus in the Village
description: "I can't give credit. Come back when you're a little... mmmm, richer!"
body:
**This pack has only been tested on Minecraft 1.16.4! If there are any issues please report in the Discord server.**

---

From the mind of a 2020 ChaoDee, comes Morshus in the Village, a classic resource pack for Minecraft 1.16 to give you the best salesman pitches from all of Hyrule, now inside a sandbox video game!

This resource pack replaces subtitles and villager sounds to become Morshu. To search for a villager, you now need to search 'Morshu'. The pack does literally nothing else but add Morshu's murmur.
